actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes official version

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.35 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.35' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.35.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25
actions.description: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Functions support for Java 8, 11, and 17 is ending. Apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service. Upgrade to Java 25
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes official version

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.35 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.35' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.35.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Upgrade apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25
actions.description: Upgrade apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure App Service support for Java 8, 11, and 17 is ending. Security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer support. Upgrade to Java 25.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade App Service apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade App Service apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind !has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25
actions.description: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Functions support for Java 8, 11, and 17 is ending. Apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service. Upgrade to Java 25
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

resources

| where isnull(properties.availabilitySet.id) and isnull(zones) and isnull(properties.host) and isnull(properties.virtualMachineScaleSet)

actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes official version

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.35 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.35 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.35' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.35.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

descriptionOfChanges: The Bv2 series does not include temporary (local) storage, enabling lower cost difference and substantial price‑performance gains for workloads that do not require it.

actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes official version

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.34 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.34' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.34.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Transition from Pod name dimension to Prometheus
actions.description: Transition from Pod name dimension to Prometheus

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: AKS Pod name dimension within kube_pod_status_phase and kube_pod_status_ready platform metrics is retiring. To continue using the pod name dimension switch to Azure Monitor Managed Prometheus.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Transition AKS pod name dimension to use Azure Monitor Managed Prometheus.
advisor_metadata.label: Transition AKS pod name dimension to use Azure Monitor Managed Prometheus.
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
resources
| where type == "microsoft.insights/metricalerts"
| extend criteria = properties.criteria.allOf
| mv-expand scope = properties.scopes
| mv-expand criterion = criteria
| where tostring(criterion.metricName) in ("kube_pod_status_ready", "kube_pod_status_phase")
| extend id = tostring(scope)
| where id has "/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/"
| distinct subscriptionId, id
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.description: Upgrade apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure App Service support for Java 8, 11, and 17 is ending. Security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer support. Upgrade to Java 25.
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade App Service apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade App Service apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind !has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25
actions.description: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11, and 17 to Java 25

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Functions support for Java 8, 11, and 17 is ending. Apps that are hosted on Azure Functions will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service. Upgrade to Java 25
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade Function Apps from Java 8, 11 and 17 to Java 25
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

| where type =~ 'microsoft.web/sites'
| where kind has 'functionapp'
| extend configuredJavaVersion = tostring(properties.siteConfig.javaVersion)
| extend linuxFxVersion = toupper(tostring(properties.siteConfig.linuxFxVersion))
| extend javaVersion = case(
    configuredJavaVersion in~ ('1.8', '8', '8.0'), '8',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '11', '11',
    configuredJavaVersion startswith '17', '17',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|8', '8',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|11', '11',
    linuxFxVersion startswith 'JAVA|17', '17',
    ''
)
| where javaVersion in ('8', '11', '17')
| project subscriptionId, id

actions.caption: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes official version
actions.description: Upgrade AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes official version

advisor_metadata.detailedDescription: Azure Kubernetes Service retires 1.34 Kubernetes Official version. To stay within supported versions and service-level agreements (SLA), upgrade to a supported version within 30 days after Azure removes version 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.displayName: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.label: Upgrade your AKS cluster from 1.34 Kubernetes Official version
advisor_metadata.recommendationDataSourceQuery:
Resources 
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters' 
| extend props = todynamic(properties) 
| mv-expand ap = props.agentPoolProfiles 
| extend currentOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend requestedOrchestratorVersion = tostring(ap.orchestratorVersion) 
| extend orchestratorVersion = iff( 
    isempty(currentOrchestratorVersion), 
    requestedOrchestratorVersion, 
    currentOrchestratorVersion) 
| extend supportPlan = tostring(props.supportPlan) 
| where (orchestratorVersion == '1.34' 
    or orchestratorVersion startswith '1.34.') 
| where supportPlan =~ 'KubernetesOfficial' 
| project subscriptionId, id
